segments.snp5.2:3.4: Sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūhi, kena sotā pidhiyyare”[pithiyyare (sī. syā. pī.), pithīyare (sī. aṭṭha.), pidhīyare (?)].
segments.snp5.2:5.1: “Paññā ceva sati yañca [satī ceva (sī.), satī ca (syā.), satī cāpi (pī. niddesa), sati cāpi (niddesa)],(iccāyasmā ajito)
segments.snp5.2:5.4: Etaṃ me puṭṭho pabrūhi, katthetaṃ uparujjhati”.
segments.snp5.2:6.1: “Yametaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi, ajita taṃ vadāmi te;
segments.snp5.2:7.1: “Ye ca saṅkhātadhammāse, ye ca sekhā puthū idha;
segments.snp5.2:7.3: Tesaṃ me nipako iriyaṃ, puṭṭho pabrūhi mārisa”.

lines: Kissābhilepanaṃ brūsīti kiṃ assa lokassa abhilepanaṃ vadesi.
